terms.subtitle: Please read the terms and conditions governing the Smart Building Configurator platform.
paragraphs: By using the Smart Building Configurator, you agree to use the platform for legitimate project estimation and communication with the provider team.
The platform generates budgetary technical and financial offers based on the configuration data you provide. Final contract, procurement, and implementation terms are confirmed separately in writing.
You are responsible for providing accurate project details, contact information, and account data. Inaccurate data may affect output quality, pricing, and follow-up communication.
Generated offers, pricing logic, documentation templates, and platform content remain proprietary to the service provider unless explicitly agreed otherwise.
The provider may update platform features, pricing rules, integrations, and workflows to improve reliability, compliance, and business operations.

privacy.subtitle: How account, project, and communication data are processed in the platform.
paragraphs: The platform stores account, project, configuration, offer, and communication preference data required to generate quotations and maintain your customer workspace.
Verification channels (email and SMS), reminders, and operational notifications are processed through integrated providers (SendGrid and Twilio) according to configured delivery settings.
Only authorized personnel can access backoffice and customer data through role-based permissions and authenticated API endpoints.
Data is retained for operational, legal, and support purposes as required by business and compliance obligations.
You can request profile updates and communication preference changes from your account profile, and platform operators can assist with formal data requests.

cookies.subtitle: How cookies and local storage are used in the platform.
paragraphs: Cookies and local storage are used to preserve language preference, session state, configurator progress, and quality-of-use settings.
Essential storage is required for authentication, navigation, and quote workflow continuity. Optional preferences can be accepted or declined from the cookie banner.
You can clear browser storage at any time; this may reset unsynchronized local progress and preferences.
